messages.text: Morning all. Ahead of Friday's go/no-go, here's where we are against the board's three conditions: (a) permissions remediation — 97% complete, last 11 sites being fixed today; (b) Case Management and Learner Files excluded from Copilot search — done and tested; (c) Copilot Essentials mandatory before licence — live in the CPD portal, 38 people completed already.
Great progress. What's the risk if we go with 97%?
The remaining 11 sites are old project sites with 'Everyone except external users' access. Low sensitivity, but I'd rather finish them. I'll confirm 100% by Thursday 5pm.
From finance: licences are budgeted. Please can we make sure Ledgerline exports in the Finance site are labelled Confidential before wave 1 — some include salary data.
Yes — auto-labelling policy for anything with salary or NI numbers goes live tomorrow.
Delivery view: coaches are keen, but I don't want wave 2 landing on the same week as the November ILR. Can wave 2 be 23 Nov rather than 16th?
Fine by me. Wave 1 (central teams + delivery managers) 9 Nov, wave 2 (coaches and tutors) 23 Nov.
One request from Quality: Copilot must not be used to write progress review judgements or EPA readiness decisions. Can that be explicit in the training and the AI Acceptable Use Policy?
It's in section 5 of the AUP v2.0 already, but I'll add a slide to Copilot Essentials so it's unmissable.
People team ready with comms and FAQs. Jess has the Hub article and the Digest piece lined up for 30 Oct.
Confirmed: permissions remediation 100% complete. Salary auto-labelling live. All three board conditions met.

Thank you all. Decision: **GO**. Wave 1 on Monday 9 November, wave 2 on Monday 23 November. Aisha to report adoption, time saved and any data incidents to the January board. Oliver, please record this against action A-2610-01.
Recorded — A-2610-01 marked complete, decision noted for the next exec meeting minutes.
